claims: Artemis II is a manned mission.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight of NASA's Artemis program.
Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II involves a 10-day journey around the Moon.
Artemis II marks the first human flight beyond low Earth orbit since 1972.
Artemis II is a crewed lunar flyby (no landing).
The Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The objective of Artemis II is to test NASA's deep-space systems, specifically the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with humans aboard.
The launch vehicle for Artemis II is the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
